details:
When I first joined VRChat back in late 2020, there was a Winter Spotlight category in the World Menu that featured a curated list of winter-themed worlds like Yayoi Winter Onsen, Moscow Trip 2002, and for some reason, Deep Blue.
Not only was it a great way of finding cool new worlds, it was a great way of finding worlds *with people in them*. Players gravitate towards worlds that are at the top of the menu. The category would refresh every day, giving you populated worlds to go hang out that weren't just the same handful of worlds that are always at the top of the Hot and Active My Platform categories. The current Spotlight category features some of VRChat's truly exceptional worlds, but it's rarely updated and doesn't quite fulfill the same purpose as the Winter Spotlight one I remember.
I'd love to see a similar category come back in the future to help populate great worlds and give them more than the 15 minutes of fame that they get when they're at the top of the New category.
title: Seasonal Spotlight World Category
